parameters.name: AccessGroup
parameters.description:
The permission group name.

This parameter is required if the file system is a General-purpose NAS file system.

Default permission group: DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME (the default permission group for VPCs).

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of access point tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

Limits:

- Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length.
- The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:.
- The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

Limits:

- Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length.
- The tag value cannot start with aliyun or acs:.
- The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://.
